Looks like just need to make server final in this line: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/src/tools/remote_worker/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/remote/RemoteWorker.java#L130

Not sure why jdk8 didn't complain about it..
Thanks for responding so quickly!  Yeah, JDK 8 loosened the requirements for what needs to be final in closures.

No problem. I just happen to see the email on the screen.

Patch here: https://bazel-review.googlesource.com/#/c/3630/

I uploaded a speculative fix here: https://bazel-review.googlesource.com/#/c/3631/

Is it possible there are multiple instances of the same test running at the same time? Once the test is completed the listening process should be teared down.
I can change it so that each test instance starts with a random port number. This will it should avoid reused port when multiple instances of the tests are running.
I think using pick_random_unused_port would probably be safer.
